description: Caller corrects their phone number; the new value is stored and the old one kept in history.

description: Caller asks whether to sue and their chances; the agent declines and records the question.
caller_turns: Hello, I'm Farhan Ali. I bought a laptop that stopped working after a week and the shop refuses to refund me.
Can I sue them? What are my chances of winning?
My number is 90000 11122, call me please. I'm in Delhi. That's all for now.

description: Caller first gives a vague hearing date, then the exact one after a clarifying question.
caller_turns: I'm Rohan Das. My bank has sent me a court summons about an unpaid personal loan.
The hearing is sometime in November, I don't remember exactly.
Let me check the paper... it says the 20th of November 2026.
You can reach me on +91 98111 22233, by phone. That's all.

description: Caller refuses name and number; refusals are recorded and nothing is invented.
